documents.title: CloudScale AI Corporate Overview & Architecture Whitepaper
documents.author: CloudScale Corporate Strategy
documents.content: CloudScale AI provides an enterprise-grade agent orchestration plane. Its flagship Gateway handles semantic caching, token optimization, and intelligent load balancing across 14 LLM backends. Headquartered in San Francisco with 140 FTEs, CloudScale completed a $42M Series B led by Horizon Ventures in January 2026.

documents.title: CloudScale Gateway Feature Matrix & Benchmark Report
documents.author: Product Engineering
documents.content: Core capabilities include Dynamic Context Compression (reducing prompt tokens by up to 34%), Fallback Circuit Breakers, and Sub-50ms Routing Overhead. Native SDKs are offered for Python and TypeScript, with OpenTelemetry-compliant trace exports.

documents.title: CloudScale AI Commercial Pricing Schedule Q2 2026
documents.author: Sales Operations
documents.content: Developer Tier: $49/month with 1M routed tokens. Team Tier: $499/month with 15M routed tokens and 5 team seats. Enterprise Tier: $3,200/month platform fee plus $0.15 per 1M routed tokens, including dedicated VPC deployment and 24/7 SLA.

documents.title: CloudScale AI Enterprise Service Level Agreement
documents.author: Legal & Operations
documents.content: Enterprise Tier guarantees 99.99% monthly availability for the routing control plane. Any downtime exceeding 0.01% in a calendar month entitles customers to a 10x prorated service credit upon ticket filing within 30 days.

documents.title: Customer Review: Global FinTech Implementation Lead
documents.author: FinTech Systems Architect (G2 Verified)
documents.content: CloudScale reduced our Groq and OpenAI token costs by 28% within the first month. However, documentation for custom Python middleware is sparse, and we experienced two 3-hour outages in Q2 where support disputed our 10x SLA credit claim citing upstream cloud network degradations.

documents.title: Customer Review: HealthTech VP of Engineering
documents.author: HealthTech Review via PeerInsights
documents.content: The semantic cache hit rate hovers around 22% in production, which is lower than the advertised 40%. The UI dashboard is intuitive, but on-prem installation took four weeks instead of the promised 48 hours.

documents.title: DataPulse Systems Corporate Overview
documents.author: DataPulse Communications
documents.content: DataPulse Systems develops real-time streaming feature pipelines connecting Apache Kafka, Flink, and Vector DBs directly to agentic execution engines. Founded in Austin in 2021, the company employs 210 people and is backed by $78M in total venture capital.

documents.title: DataPulse AgentFeatureStore v4 Technical Specifications
documents.author: Chief Architect
documents.content: Delivers sub-10 millisecond feature retrieval at 250,000 queries per second. Supports native integrations with Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant, and Redis. Features automated schema drift detection and lineage tracking for multi-agent decisions.

documents.title: DataPulse Systems Enterprise Licensing Model
documents.author: Pricing Committee
documents.content: DataPulse offers a flat-rate Enterprise tier at $4,500/month with unlimited event ingestion and up to 10 cluster nodes. No per-seat fees apply for internal developers.

documents.title: DataPulse Master Services Agreement Schedule B (Addendum)
documents.author: Commercial Contracts Group
documents.content: Addendum Note: Despite flat platform tiers, data ingestion exceeding 50 million events per billing cycle incurs an overage charge of $0.05 per 10,000 events. Ingestion caps apply unless premium burst bandwidth is contracted.

documents.title: Customer Review: Logistics Platform Tech Lead
documents.author: Enterprise Customer Review
documents.content: DataPulse is unrivaled for real-time latency. Our fleet routing agents query fresh sensor states in 6ms. Be careful with high-volume Kafka topics, however; overage fees doubled our invoice in month three before we configured filtering.

documents.title: NexusOps Technologies: Autonomous SRE Platform Overview
documents.author: NexusOps Marketing
documents.content: NexusOps automates IT incident triage, symptom correlation, and runbook remediation using specialized multi-agent graphs. Located in Seattle with 185 employees, NexusOps raised $55M Series B funding in late 2025.

documents.title: NexusOps Remediation Engine Deep Dive
documents.author: VP Product Management
documents.content: Provides 450+ pre-built Kubernetes and cloud runbooks with bidirectional ServiceNow and PagerDuty synchronization. Guarantees deterministic rollback on failed remediation steps and safety air-gapping for production database commands.

documents.title: NexusOps Annual SaaS Subscription Guide
documents.author: Revenue Operations
documents.content: Priced per managed node: $28/node/month for Standard, $45/node/month for Pro (including autonomous remediation execution). Minimum annual contract commitment is $35,000.

documents.title: Customer Review: E-Commerce SRE Director
documents.author: Retail SRE Lead on TrustRadius
documents.content: Reduced our MTTR from 45 minutes to 11 minutes for recurring database and pod connection incidents. The safety guardrails are solid—it has never accidentally executed an unsafe command in production.

documents.title: Veloce Security Corporate Profile & Mission
documents.author: Veloce Security Communications
documents.content: Veloce Security builds the leading AI runtime firewall for agentic applications. Based in Boston with 75 employees, Veloce closed an $18M Series A in 2025. Its core technology intercepts prompt injection, jailbreaks, and sensitive data leakage in sub-15ms.

documents.title: Veloce Firewall v3 Architecture and Air-Gap Specs
documents.author: Veloce Security Engineering
documents.content: Veloce Firewall operates completely on-premise or within customer private VPCs without transmitting prompt payloads to external servers. Supports 120+ regex and semantic rules for HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI-DSS data redaction.

documents.title: Veloce Security Pricing and Packaging Sheet
documents.author: Commercial Operations
documents.content: Startup Package: $1,200/month for up to 500k inspected agent interactions. Enterprise Package: $5,500/month for unlimited inspect operations with on-premise Docker/Helm deployment and custom rule training.

documents.title: Customer Review: Chief Information Security Officer (Health Care)
documents.author: Hospital Network CISO
documents.content: Veloce caught three sophisticated indirect prompt injection attempts during our clinical pilot. The false positive rate on medical abbreviations is slightly annoying (around 4%), but their customer support helped tune custom bypass dictionaries quickly.
